query: CDC FluView influenza surveillance weekly report MMWR week 40 2024 United States cases hospitalizations deaths
query_rationale: CDC FluView is the definitive U.S. influenza surveillance system. MMWR week 40 (Sep 29–Oct 5, 2024) is the exact epidemiological week matching the task window. This query targets the weekly FluView report that would contain confirmed cases, ILI percentages, hospitalizations, and deaths at national and HHS-region level.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC FluView weekly report or interactive dashboard page for week 40 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, MMWR week 40 label, official surveillance tables

query: site:cdc.gov influenza "week 40" OR "October 2024" surveillance 2024-2025 season United States
query_rationale: A site-restricted query to cdc.gov ensures results come directly from CDC. Combining 'week 40' and 'October 2024' with the 2024-2025 season label maximizes the chance of retrieving the FluView weekly update, flu activity maps, or any CDC situation reports published during or shortly after the task window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC FluView interactive, CDC flu activity summary, CDC MMWR early release
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, 2024-2025 season reference, week 40 label

query: WHO PAHO influenza update United States "week 40" OR "late September 2024" OR "early October 2024" cases deaths surveillance
query_rationale: WHO and PAHO publish weekly global and regional influenza updates that include U.S. data sourced from CDC. These serve as independent validation of CDC figures and may include additional epidemiological context such as strain characterization and severity indicators for the task window.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: WHO global influenza update, PAHO epidemiological alert or weekly bulletin
expected_trust_signal: who.int or paho.org domain, week 40 2024 reference, U.S. data table

query: influenza United States "flu season" cases deaths hospitalizations "October 2024" OR "September 2024" report
query_rationale: News and media sources may report on the start of the 2024-2025 U.S. flu season in late September/early October 2024, citing official CDC figures or state health department data. This query captures any subnational or national case/death counts reported in the press during or immediately after the task window, which can supplement official surveillance data.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: News articles from major outlets (AP, Reuters, NPR, local health news) citing CDC or state health department flu data
expected_trust_signal: Publication date within or shortly after Sep 29–Oct 5 2024, citation of CDC or state health agency as source

query: WHO global influenza update week 40 2024 United States cases surveillance October 2024
query_rationale: WHO publishes weekly global influenza updates that include U.S. data sourced from CDC FluView. This query targets the WHO bulletin covering MMWR week 40 (ending October 5, 2024) to provide independent corroboration of CDC figures and potentially additional epidemiological context (strain characterization, severity). This was planned as it1_q3 but not executed.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: WHO global influenza update bulletin or situation report for week 40 2024, referencing U.S. surveillance data
expected_trust_signal: who.int domain, week 40 2024 reference, U.S. data table or narrative
previous_iteration_basis: it1_q3 planned but not executed; CDC-only results in iteration 1 leave WHO/PAHO validation gap

query: PAHO influenza epidemiological update Americas "week 40" 2024 United States
query_rationale: PAHO publishes regional influenza epidemiological updates for the Americas that include U.S. data. Targeting week 40 2024 specifically increases the chance of retrieving a bulletin that covers the exact task window and provides regional/subnational context not always present in WHO global updates.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: PAHO epidemiological alert, weekly bulletin, or situation report for week 40 2024 covering the Americas including the U.S.
expected_trust_signal: paho.org domain, week 40 2024 label, U.S. data reference
previous_iteration_basis: it1_q3 planned but not executed; complements WHO query with PAHO-specific regional coverage

query: CDC FluSurv-NET influenza hospitalization surveillance week 40 2024 "2024-2025" season rates United States
query_rationale: FluSurv-NET is the CDC's population-based surveillance network for laboratory-confirmed influenza hospitalizations, covering select counties in 14 states (~10% of U.S. population). Hospitalization data is a key target field not fully captured by the main FluView weekly report snippet. Targeting week 40 2024 specifically may surface the FluSurv-NET data table or the NCHS mortality surveillance component, filling the hospitalizations and deaths fields.
expected_source_type_or_evidence: CDC FluSurv-NET weekly hospitalization rate table or NCHS influenza mortality data for week 40 2024
expected_trust_signal: cdc.gov domain, FluSurv-NET label, week 40 2024 reference, hospitalization rate per 100,000
